name: duplicate-intake
story: The voice channel sends a call's completion event twice. Intake keys on the channel's conversation id, so there is one conversation, one lead and one delivery. A different call from the same firm is a different conversation and its own lead.
proves: docs/rfc/008_delivery_guarantees_and_evidence.md#41-the-boundaries (channel to conversation, and conversation to lead, are idempotent)
today: The lab has no conversation record: every publish makes a new lead id (Dispatch.publish), so a repeated event would be a second lead with its own deliveries. In production, api-2 answers 208 Already Reported for an answer_id it already has (docs/lead-delivery/production-today.md).
